acceptedScope: Parent source accepts P2 final native proof ordering; whole candidate pending

cases.name: producer-original-context-subscription-retry
cases.source: A genuine SDK-invoked producer calls the original failed context subscription retry. Busy permits retry, the original notifier raises contextNotificationDepth and the subscriber uses the same valid token/lease/custody/current-context.
cases.expected: Binding false in the subscriber; notification finally restores depth and normal authentic producer binding may resume. No public subscription behavior is changed.

cases.name: ordinary-context-notification-entry
cases.source: Original publish/update/draft/switch/dispose context publication and subscription retries all enter the same original notifier.
cases.expected: Every listener runs with positive contextNotificationDepth, so binding refuses regardless of the preserved producer frame.

cases.name: retained-lifetime-listener-and-retry
cases.source: Original retained-owner notification and lifetime subscription retry use listenerNotificationDepth.
cases.expected: The original retained notificationActive guard refuses binding during every listener.

cases.name: original-retirement-notifications
cases.source: Original adapter pre-retirement and retained owner/authority retirement subscriber paths use retirementPending, retirementActivityDepth and ownerRetirementDepth.
cases.expected: Adapter retirement and original retained notification/retry activity guards refuse binding.

cases.name: normal-producer-after-notification-finally
cases.source: Original notification finally releases its activity depth; the same actual SDK producer frame/transition remains valid and no source/lease/scope invalidation occurred.
cases.expected: Normal producer binding true; outside the original producer frame false.

cases.name: throw-undefined-or-caught-reentry
cases.source: Original subscriber/producer throws undefined or catches nested control failure during retry.
cases.expected: Original finally clears frame/depth and existing cleanup/failure carriers preserve actual raw first/latest cause and unfinished obligations. No lease or envelope replacement.
